_comment: Review ledger for scripts/check_tags.py. A patch line that names an item but is not tagged to it is UNREVIEWED, and --check exits 1 on any of them. Recording it here says 'looked at it, it does not belong' and retires it from the queue. This exists so the noise of a first sweep is paid for once: the queue after that only ever holds genuinely new pairings, from a new patch or a newly added item.
_when_to_use_this_file: Only for one-off rejections, where a specific line mentions an item but means something else. If the same false match recurs across many lines, it is a pattern, not a one-off: put it in the item's own `tag_deny` (masked phrases) or set `tag_name: false` on the item instead. Those live with the item, are read by both matchers, and document themselves. Today every rejection is a pattern, which is why this list is empty.
_key_format: <sha1(version + heading trail + text)[:12]>|<slug>. Not the array index, which build_patch_data.py --init renumbers, and not the text alone, which collides: 1.3.1.0 prints the same damage line under both the SLM-93A and 9K93 IGLA sub-headings. scripts/check_tags.py prints the key next to every unreviewed line, so copy it from there.

_example.0123456789ab|support: The "Steady Aim" here is the bolt-action hold-breath prompt, a different mechanic from the Fire Support ability of the same name.
